title: ProvocationProbe: Instigating Hate Speech Dataset from Twitter
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset (ProvocationProbe) used to evaluate hate speech specifically targeting religious identities and practices. It analyzes several religious controversies in depth, such as the 'Hijab Row', 'Love Jihad', and 'Satan Shoes' (mocking Christianity), and identifies religious groups (Muslims, Hindus, and Christians) as targeted subjects of instigating hate.
